title: Bộ luyện tập 30 tình huống · quan sát 2024H1 · kiểm thử 24 tháng

warmup.rationale: Max form period is 252 (Donchian, ROC); MA Cross slow is 250 and needs a prior bar for the crossing test, so at least 253 closes are required for a valid first observation session. 300 sessions are required and 520 (about two years) are requested so Wilder/EMA smoothing of the longest forms (EMA 200, MACD 100+30, DMI 50) is converged before the first observation session. Warmup bars are server-side only and are never sent to a client.
